id: \bI specialise in turning Apricorns into Poké Balls.
en: \bI specialise in turning Apricorns into Poké Balls.
it: \bSono specializzato nel trasformare le Ghicocche in Poké Ball.

id: \bIf you like, I can convert one of yours into a Poké Ball.
en: \bIf you like, I can convert one of yours into a Poké Ball.
it: \bSe vuoi, posso trasformare una delle tue in una Poké Ball.

id: \bHello again. Do you have an Apricorn for me?
en: \bHello again. Do you have an Apricorn for me?
it: \bCiao di nuovo. Hai una Ghicocca per me?

id: <c2=6546675A>Which Apricorn would you like me to convert?
en: <c2=6546675A>Which Apricorn would you like me to convert?

id: \bLet me know when you want me to convert an Apricorn for you.
en: \bLet me know when you want me to convert an Apricorn for you.
it: \bFammi sapere quando vuoi che ti trasformi una Ghicocca.

id: \bCome back when you have an Apricorn for me.
en: \bCome back when you have an Apricorn for me.
it: \bTorna quando avrai una Ghicocca per me.

id: \bOkay. I'll turn your \v[3] into a Poké Ball for you.
en: \bOkay. I'll turn your \v[3] into a Poké Ball for you.
it: \bD'accordo. Trasformerò la tua \v[3] in una Poké Ball.

id: \bI've been waiting for you. I've completed the Poké Ball you asked me to make.
en: \bI've been waiting for you. I've completed the Poké Ball you asked me to make.
it: \bTi stavo aspettando. Ho finito la Poké Ball che mi hai chiesto.

id: \bYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.
en: \bYou have no room left. Make room, then come see me.
it: \bNon hai più spazio. Fai spazio, poi torna da me.

id: \bI tried making a Poké Ball out of what you gave me, but it didn't work.
en: \bI tried making a Poké Ball out of what you gave me, but it didn't work.
it: \bHo provato a fare una Poké Ball con quello che mi hai dato, ma non ha funzionato.

id: \bI'm still working on your Apricorn. Come back later.
en: \bI'm still working on your Apricorn. Come back later.
it: \bSto ancora lavorando alla tua Ghicocca. Torna più tardi.
